card.name: ISSN and Unix path pieces
card.fires_on: The word ISSN before a journal number, and short pieces of Unix paths or server names such as www, tmp and mysqld in technical text.

modes.label: ISSN label
modes.description: The word ISSN just before a journal serial number in a citation.

modes.label: Unix path parts
modes.description: Directory or program name parts like www, tmp or mysqld in Linux or server text.

card.plain: It fires on the label ISSN in journal citations and on pieces of computer file paths, which have nothing to do with drug labels.
